concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Personally inspected three fossil photographs and the genuine concept. Preserve full-length leaf cover and branching silhouette. Correct the concept broad thick triangular leaves into slender swept blades approximately35-60mm long and3-5mm wide with subtle thickness; these are design dimensions, not measurements of the fossils. Reduce leaf count to roughly500-650 while retaining spiral attachment on all axes. Use a low horizontal-to-ascending basal axis with paired forks and unequal terminal branches, not a radial fan of disconnected shoots. Branch layout and small basal rooting connector are explicitly artistic where unpreserved. Keep upper branch spaces open and leaves single, unbranched and non-whorled. No soil base, large modern tree roots, cones or flowers.
